metadata.name: json_single_record_sample_rules
metadata.description: Business rules for the JSON (NDJSON) single-record worked example (ADR 0018). Drives the actual pass/fail checks the mapping alone only profiles: a required nested path, a valid_values allowlist, a numeric type, and an array-length minimum on the parser's count column.

rules.name: CUSTOMER_ID required (nested path present)
rules.description: The customer.id JSON path must resolve (key present). Flags line 9 where customer.id is absent.

rules.name: STATUS valid values
rules.description: Account status must be one of the allowlist. Flags line 8 ('FROZEN').
rules.message: STATUS must be one of ACTIVE/CLOSED/SUSPENDED

rules.name: AGE numeric
rules.description: Age must be numeric. Flags line 10 ('NaN').

rules.name: At least one transaction
rules.description: Every customer must carry at least one transaction. Runs json_array_length against the TXN_COUNT_count column the parser emits from $.transactions[*]. Flags line 6 (empty transactions array).
rules.message: Each record must carry at least one transaction
